title: std::geometric_distribution<IntType>::p
summary: Returns the p distribution parameter the distribution was constructed with. The parameter defines the probability of a trial generating true.
html:
double p() const;
 (since C++11)

Returns the p distribution parameter the distribution was constructed with. The parameter defines the probability of a trial generating true. The default value is 0.5.

Parameters

(none)

Return value

Floating point value identifying the p distribution parameter.

See also

(C++11)
 gets or sets the distribution parameter object
